I am an Informatics Engineering graduate specializing in UI/UX Design, Front-End & Mobile Development, and AI-driven digital solutions. Backed by a strong academic foundation and a deep passion for technology, I am dedicated to transforming user research into intuitive, visually engaging, and high-impact digital products.

Throughout my professional journey, I have managed the entire product design lifecycle—from user research, wireframing, and interactive prototyping in Figma, to translating design systems into responsive code using React, Flutter, Tailwind CSS, and C#. My internship experiences across corporate and government institutions, paired with leadership roles in tech organizations, have sharpened my abilities in cross-functional collaboration, complex problem-solving, and delivering scalable software.

My commitment to innovation is reflected in winning multiple International Gold Medals and Special Awards at prestigious technology expositions in Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia (including IPITEX, WICE, WYIE, and GYIC). I am driven to continuously expand my technical stack and engineer state-of-the-art digital experiences in fast-paced environments.

Customers can easily browse products, select nearby depots, and track orders in real time, while resellers utilize a dedicated dashboard to manage inventory and process requests through an asymmetric bento-grid layout with multi-language support (English, Indonesian, Mandarin).

A voice-powered personal expense tracking web app that allows users to record daily spending simply by speaking aloud in natural Indonesian speech, parsing item names, amounts, and categories automatically.
